answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the pigment of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a narrative-driven, real-world analogies register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the onyx of a task receipt, and the ripple is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on verifiable random functions for fair selection.
